findings.finding: Base-metal tailwind into Q3: Q2 metals EBITDA nearly tripled (29m vs 10m PLN) on higher base-metal prices, and LME copper stayed elevated through Q3 2026 while aluminium gave up its war premium, so Q3 metals EBITDA most likely beats Q3 2025's 19m and group EBITDA beats Q3 2025's 54m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 (EBITDA +65% y/y, metals tripled): +0.2% close-to-close on 2026-08-13 (+~3% intraday per Parkiet). Q3 2025 (stable results): +3.1% on 2025-11-19. Q1 2026 (+10.7% EBITDA): -1.9%. Beats here have not been paid.
findings.original_quote: Poprawa rentowności segmentu wynikała z korzystnego otoczenia rynkowego, w tym wyższych notowań metali bazowych (The segment's improved profitability came from a favourable market backdrop, including higher base-metal prices)
findings.why_not_priced: No analyst publishes a Q3 number on this name and turnover is $0.13m/day, so nobody has turned the Q3 metal-price path into a figure. Had the market priced a strong Q3, the stock would have moved in Oct as metals rose. Instead it slid from 4.68 to 4.35 PLN through October and only rose on the drone licence. Partly priced, because the Q2 report told the market the driver.
findings.independence: Independent price series: copper stayed elevated while aluminium lost its war premium, OilPrice 2026-10-21 https://oilprice.com/Metals/Commodities/Aluminium-Gives-Up-Its-War-Premium-Copper-Stays-Elevated.html. Mixed for Skawina (aluminium), positive for copper/brass processing. Net of the rest of the group: Energy is shrinking (Q2 EBITDA 2m) and Automotive was only flat y/y in Q2.

findings.finding: The Walcownia Metali Dziedzice layoff of about 200 of 447 staff ran end-August to end-November 2026, so a severance/restructuring charge most likely lands in Q3 reported EBITDA or net profit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to a Boryszew restructuring charge. 2024-25 steel-area closures were booked as one-offs and the company reports EBITDA ex one-offs, which the press headlines.
findings.source_date: 2026-07 (page date not confirmed from the URL; corroborated by bankier.pl 2026-07-17)
findings.why_not_priced: The layoff is public, but its cost has never been quantified. It is a one-off with a path to the guide only through lower steel-area losses later (9M 2025 steel EBITDA was about -22m), which partly offsets it. So the finding is small and could flip positive if management frames it as fixing the loss-maker.

findings.finding: The stock ran from 4.345 to 5.06 PLN (+16%) in the five sessions before the print, on the 12 Nov Hornet licence (an associate, 48%, with no revenue yet). A quarterly report adds nothing new on drones, which sets up a sell-the-news risk on a thin name whose last strong beat closed flat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: April 2025 drone news moved the stock about +40% in a session (baseline history, 2025-04-22). Results days since have moved -4.2% to +3.1%.
findings.original_quote: Zarząd oczekuje, że uzyskanie koncesji umożliwi rozpoczęcie produkcji seryjnej bezzałogowych statków powietrznych po zakończeniu fazy niezbędnych testów i certyfikacji (The board expects the licence to allow serial production of unmanned aircraft to start once the necessary testing and certification are complete)
findings.why_not_priced: Weak: this agrees with the run-up lean (-0.358), which is the free control, so it adds little that is measurable. Kept small. The only orthogonal part is that the report's management commentary could carry Hornet order or certification news, which cuts the other way.

lessons_applied: 'You were right about the number and too small about the move': abs_move_pct raised from 4.5 to 5.0. Not to 7, because no guidance is expected and the guidance-absent median is 2.3%.
'Positioning is the thing to beat, not the thing to agree with': the run-up fade finding cut from -0.3 to -0.2, because it agrees with the run-up lean that is the free control.

'A finding about a number the market has already been told' / 'a narrow proxy loses to a broad series': metals finding cut from +0.5 to +0.4, because Q2 already told the market the base-metal driver and the Q3 read is a price-series proxy.
Reaction-history veto (Q2 beat closed +0.2%): p_up held near 50 (48 to 49) rather than leaning on the beat.
